title: Insights Library
meta_description: Perspectives across eight deep-tech domains — retrieval economics, agentic policy, PQC clocks, provenance compliance and more.

blocks.x: Perspectives from the delivery floor — engineering notes, market views and honest lessons.
The Insights library is organized by tower. Articles are short, evidence-anchored and written by the practices that ship the work — no vendor-think-piece register.

Every article carries three things: the delivery position (what we believe and why), the evidence (benchmarks with classical baselines, program numbers), and the transfer path (which services and platforms deliver the pattern). Where the honest answer is 'it depends', we say what it depends on.

items: Strategy, model selection, retrieval, evaluation and the operations that keep models accurate in production. We start from the business metric, not the model.
Goal-directed agents that run inside your systems with defined roles, budgets and human checkpoints. Every action is logged, measurable and reversible.
Pipelines, lakehouse and governance built so reports reconcile, lineage is traceable end to end, and access is controlled without slowing teams down.
Identity-first architecture covering workforce, customer and machine access, with detection, response and AI-specific controls in one program.
Hybrid and edge estates engineered for reliability, cost per workload and clean day-two operations, with an internal platform your teams actually adopt.
Optimization, simulation and post-quantum cryptography migration, applied where the mathematics pays back and benchmarked against classical baselines.
Permissioned networks, tokenization and verifiable credentials with the reporting and controls supervisors expect.
Sensor integration, digital twins and robotics that let operations teams see, simulate and act on physical assets in one loop.
